justification: DB update script modifying 7 production rows with extracted DCP values. No schema changes, no frontend changes. Standard because data is user-visible but script is idempotent.

pre_impl.existing_data: dcp_setback_controls table — 7 rows with needs_review=true, ids 1080-1090
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: If row id doesn't exist or lga/control_type changed, script prints SKIP and doesn't update. No silent failures.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Updates existing rows only (by id). No new rows inserted. Verification query checks id + is_current + lga + control_type match.

functions.name: main
functions.input: UPDATES list (7 dicts with id, lga, control_type, values) + DATABASE_URL from .env
functions.output: 7 UPDATE statements to dcp_setback_controls, sets needs_review=false, updates value_min/max, condition, source_text, section_ref, review_reason, reviewed_at, last_verified_at, extraction_method
functions.if_none: If DATABASE_URL missing, exits with error message. If row not found, prints SKIP.

values.guard_at: update_needs_review_controls.py:207-212 — verifies row exists and lga/control_type match before UPDATE

values.nullable: yes — None for not_applicable rows, numeric for resolved rows
values.guard_at: N/A — NULL is the correct DB value for not_applicable controls
values.if_missing: Row displays as 'no rate' in frontend (correct for not_applicable)

queries.purpose: Verify row exists and matches expected lga/control_type before update
queries.if_wrong: Additional lga/control_type check catches mismatch — prints SKIP

queries.if_zero: Row already verified to exist in prior SELECT
queries.if_wrong: Primary key ensures single row affected

break_it.scenario: Verify query returns 0 rows (row deleted or id changed since extraction)
break_it.what_happens: Script prints SKIP, row not updated, needs_review stays true
break_it.how: update_needs_review_controls.py:207-209 — if fetchone() returns None, prints SKIP and continues to next row. No crash, no silent skip.

break_it.what_happens: Same values written again, reviewed_at timestamp updated. No data corruption.
break_it.how: Idempotent — same values, same result. needs_review already false after first run.

break_it.scenario: Incorrect DCP value extracted from PDF
break_it.what_happens: User sees wrong numeric value for a control
break_it.how: Values verified against literal DCP text — source_text contains exact quote. Burwood Table 3 (3m/6m), Marrickville Table 1 (40-60%), Burwood landscaping (30%/70%).

post_merge.db_reset: No — script already executed against production DB
